title: Qualified baselines and continuation policy
summary: The 2026-08-28 19:19 ooRexx API roll-up carries Wire UI Swing v0.2-dev3 together with Builder v0.11, Server v0.17 and Alchemy Wire UI JS v0.4-dev4. A separately sealed v0.2-dev5 is newer than the roll-up Swing artifact and remains the latest qualified Swing candidate. Any unsealed dev6 work must be reconstructed/rebased from dev5 and requalified against the current Server v0.17/Builder v0.11 contracts before it can supersede dev5.
invariants: Do not silently downgrade to roll-up Swing dev3 merely because it is bundled with newer Server/Builder components.
Do not treat unsealed development notes or partially recovered trees as a release baseline.
Use sealed dev5 as the Swing implementation recovery point until a newer candidate passes complete qualification.
Requalification target is current WIRE-UI/0.1 with Server v0.17 and Builder v0.11, including workspace command/result context.
Keep generic Java Swing rules in the java sphere; keep Wire-specific renderer/protocol/qualification knowledge in this sphere.
procedure: Resolve exact source artifacts by digest.
Run strict Java, real-window, executable-JAR, ooRexx/BSF, actual Server and actual Builder acceptance.
Only then seal a successor and update this sphere continuity record.
